title: Christmas Coupons for Kids, Printable Coupon Book, Stocking Stuffer for Kids, Kids Christmas Gift, Yes Day Coupon, Instant Download
desc:
Christmas Coupons for Kids, little gifts they can redeem all winter. Hand-drawn in our whimsical pastel style by Wild Compass Print Co.

• 15 ready-made coupons: stay up late, pick the movie, yes day, build a fort and more
• 8 blank coupons to write your own
• print, cut and gift in minutes

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 3 pages: 15 ready-made coupons, a cover coupon and 8 blank coupons to fill in
• 1 download file (ZIP, unzip to open)

SIZES INCLUDED
• US Letter (8.5 x 11 in)
• A4 (210 x 297 mm)

FILE TYPES
• PDF (print-ready)

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy, then download from your Etsy Purchases page (open it in a web browser, not the app)
2. Unzip the files if needed
3. Print at home on regular paper or cardstock, cut along the dashed lines
4. Staple into a little book or tuck into a stocking

ON AN IPAD?
Open the PDF in GoodNotes or Notability to write names and notes with your Apple Pencil before printing.

NEED A DIFFERENT SIZE OR FILE TYPE?
Add our Custom Size, Ratio or File Type Add-On to your cart and tell us what you need. We'll send it within 1 to 2 business days.

PLEASE NOTE
• This is a digital download. Nothing will be mailed to you
• Frames and props in photos are not included
• Colors can look a little different on every screen and printer
• Personal use only. Please don't share or resell the files

Designed by Wild Compass Print Co. Our designs are created with the help of digital and AI tools, then reviewed and finished by us.
